title: VTC Events — Invitations — List — payload
description: List invitations: a host lists an event's invitations and their answers; a member lists their own invitations across the community's events. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

eventId.description: One event's invitations (its hosts), or the caller's to it. Absent: the caller's own across the community.

answers.description: Only invitations with one of these answers.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the caller and the filters; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 100; the responder chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

Response.title: VTC Events — Invitations — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/invitations/list/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/invitations/list/0.1#response.

items.description: Invitations: an event's, oldest first, to its hosts; the caller's own, newest first.
One invitation, and on a member's own listing its event.

event.description: The event, on the caller's own listing.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.
